_help: Photo hero images for blog posts. Photos (no text or numbers in them) are in photos/<slug>.jpg; the real, sourced figures are drawn on top by render.js. 'side' is where the figures go (the empty side of the photo). Overlay: 'chart' (bars), 'stat' (one big figure), 'stats' (two or three figures) 'budget' (from tools/yearly/gcb.json) 'ppm' (latest Mauna Loa month, from tools/ppm/ppm.json) or 'gcb' (key findings of the current edition, from tools/yearly/gcb.json). Posts that are not published yet are skipped. Share images use the bare photo, mirrored when the figures are on the right, with 'og_sub' as their line of text. Run: node tools/blog/heroes/render.js
